All 10 tests pass. 

Summary of the three surgical fixes made to `collkit.py`:

1. **`unique`** — Replaced `list(set(items))` (which loses order) with an order-preserving loop using a `seen` set, so `unique([3, 1, 3, 2, 1]) == [3, 1, 2]`.

2. **`partition`** — Returned `(no, yes)`; corrected to `(yes, no)` so the matching items come first: `partition([1,2,3,4], x>2)` now yields `([3,4], [1,2])`.

3. **`windows`** — The loop `range(0, len(items) - k)` dropped the final window; changed to `range(0, len(items) - k + 1)` so the last window is included: `windows([1,2,3,4], 2) == [[1,2],[2,3],[3,4]]`.

The other 7 functions (`chunk`, `flatten`, `group_by`, `take_while`) were left unchanged, and all 10 tests now pass.
